## Go plan

Your $1 Go plan moves from a flat $10 wallet to per-model monthly credits - one shared $10 pool, with a bigger allowance on the models we have negotiated capacity for - at your next billing cycle. It is automatic: same $1, same models, nothing to re-subscribe to. The rolling windows stay at $3 of usage in any 5 hours and $6 in any 7 days, and extra credits you have bought are untouched. Full details on the Go plan page.
